Name: Show Cookng Recipes
Author: MasterOfMutton
Description:
The mod extends the original hover tooltip - containing the name, description, price and number of times the dish have been cooked - with the ingredients required for cooking the dish.

The mod also adds an option to the end of the options menu that toggles showing unknown recipes.

Manifest.Name: Show Cooking Recipes
Manifest.Description: A mod for dispaying the recipe of cookable dishes in the collections menu.
